summary: Two files use removed lodash 3 helpers (_.pluck and _.indexBy). src/labels.js already uses _.map and must keep working. src/notes.js mentions lodash only in a string and must not be selected.
breakingChanges: lodash 4.0.0 removed _.pluck(collection, property); use _.map(collection, property). It also removed _.indexBy(collection, property); use _.keyBy(collection, property).
